How Chris Evans connects

  • Character: Chris Evans as Human Torch — Chris Evans's Human Torch credit.
  • Character: Chris Evans as Captain America — Chris Evans's Captain America credit.
  • Character: Human Torch — Chris Evans portrayed Human Torch (Fantastic Four 2005 and 2007).
  • Character: Captain America — Chris Evans portrayed Captain America (MCU).

What is Chris Evans?

Chris Evans played Johnny Storm in the 2005–07 Fantastic Four films and Steve Rogers / Captain America in the MCU. Those credits sit under each character — not under each other.

Key threads lead to Chris Evans as Human Torch, Chris Evans as Captain America, Human Torch and Captain America.
